name: wp-gclid-only-no-source-medium
description: [PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] A bare gclid with no UTMs writes ONLY the click ID field + channel label 'Google Ads'. The plugin never infers ft_source/ft_medium from click IDs.
quirk_decision: DISAGREEMENT: engine's CLICK_ID_PLATFORMS infers source=google and medium=cpc for bare gclid; plugin leaves them empty.
